verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing gives ops real-time control at auth time. Relayed authorisation sends a webhook with transaction data, including transaction rules and validation checks, and you approve or decline within 2000 ms. Transaction rules can auto-decline authorizations, 3D Secure is supported, cards can be suspended or permanently closed, and cardholders can report fraudulent transactions and lost cards via the Raise disputes API. Missing for 10: network or Adyen-native fraud scores surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerting, an explicit reissue/replace-card workflow, and independent corroboration.
